name: Princesse de Lamballe
source:
"Of course, I am one of Antoinette's attendants. I'm the one who understands her the best and I offer my services to her."

Born in Italy.
Hobby: Embroidery
Likes: Nothing in Particular
Dislikes: Nothing in Particular

[url=/c50768]Marie Antoinette's[/url] attendant.
A plain and gentle person, she doesn't like when people stand out when they shouldn't.
She didn't know what to do after her husband died, but she unexpectedly realized that she felt that being Marie's attendant is her purpose in life.
She thinks of herself as a good friend that can talk to Marie about anything.
